about: The frame for the russian-cursive widget's stroke table (build-strokes.js). S1 is unslanted about each form's baseline and scaled so its 12-unit x-height becomes xHeightUnits; the baseline goes to baselineY and each letter is centred on centerX as drawn. The widget markup applies translate(translateX, 0) skewX(skewXDeg), which restores S1's 22.5 degree slant; translateX is tan(22.5 degrees) times baselineY, rounded, so points on the baseline do not move. strokeWidth is .cursive-stroke's width in css/styles.css, used only for the clearance check (the build check reads the CSS itself).
